# Typst document text review

Reviewed on 2026-10-16. The original review and the author's FIXED/IGNORE annotations are retained below. Earlier line references describe the source at that review; the annotation check at the end uses current source locations.

## Scope and decisions

- Read all 25 `.typ` files, including the Spanish and English abstracts, headings, captions, tables, front matter, themes, and utility strings. Also inspected the editable labels in all 16 SVG diagrams and the bibliography metadata.
- Applied definite spelling, grammar, agreement, and punctuation corrections. Kept changes local to the error.
- Applied the requested terminology decision throughout the prose and captions: **aplicación anfitriona / aplicación remota**. English diagrams use the equivalent **host / remote** terminology. Updated their embedded draw.io labels and rendered SVG labels together.
- Preserved project names and code identifiers such as `parent`, `child`, `subchild`, `parentLoader`, file paths, and reference labels. “Contenedor padre” describes the DOM relationship, so it remains in [0430, line 137](sections/0430_rnd_style_injection.typ#L137) and its diagram.
- Mixing Spanish and English is acceptable. Earlier proposals to translate technical terms, change their formatting, replace conversational language, or standardize narrative tense are not applied under the current instructions. Existing changes to `main.typ` and `utils/specialWords.typ` have been preserved.
- Ambiguous meanings, possible technical inaccuracies, repeated explanations, and uncertain references are recorded below for the author to decide. They have not been rewritten or technically corrected as part of the language pass.

## Annotation check — 2026-10-16

All original issue entries have a decision, either individually or through a FIXED heading. IGNORE decisions have been respected. The findings below concern incomplete FIXED items or wording introduced while fixing them. The author's annotations have not been changed, and no document or example source has been edited in this check.

### FIXED items still open or partially resolved

1. **Function rename is incomplete, and the displayed bundles are stale.** [Example 4, line 1](../examples/04-chunks/index.ts#L1) still imports `sum`, and line 3 calls it, while [utils.ts, line 1](../examples/04-chunks/utils.ts#L1) now exports `add`. Running `node examples/04-chunks/index.ts` fails because `sum` is no longer exported. Rename that import/call and rebuild the affected examples. The existing `dist` files for examples 2, 3, and 4 still contain `sum`; Typst reads these files directly at [0410, line 164](sections/0410_rnd_why_using_a_bundler.typ#L164), [line 180](sections/0410_rnd_why_using_a_bundler.typ#L180), and [line 247](sections/0410_rnd_why_using_a_bundler.typ#L247), so the compiled document still displays the old name even where the TypeScript source is corrected.
2. **The English abstract item has not changed.** [constants.typ, line 6](utils/constants.typ#L6) still says `dynamic microfrontend loading and communication between them`. The plural antecedent and the placement of `through a programmatic approach` remain implicit. A possible replacement for the first sentence is: `App Federation is a library designed to extend Module Federation and use a programmatic approach to load microfrontends dynamically and enable communication between them.` The AI declaration itself now distinguishes original drafting from later correction.
3. **The lifecycle-object distinction is still missing.** [0300, line 758](sections/0300_project_analysis.typ#L758) now says `devuelve el ciclo de vida`, and [0500, line 145](sections/0500_user_guide.typ#L145) still says `conservar el ciclo de vida devuelto`. The original issue concerned the returned control object. Use, for example, `devuelve un objeto de control del ciclo de vida` and `conservar el objeto de control devuelto`.
4. **Compilation-time versus runtime reflection is still unspecified.** [0410, line 103](sections/0410_rnd_why_using_a_bundler.typ#L103) still moves from a bundler API to obtaining metadata `en tiempo de ejecución`. Explain whether the API inspects the project during compilation, injects metadata for runtime use, or does both. Removing the earlier parenthetical English term did not resolve this distinction.
5. **The IIFE guarantee is still too broad.** [0410, line 171](sections/0410_rnd_why_using_a_bundler.typ#L171) still describes an IIFE as guaranteeing that executed code does not affect its environment. Removing `de ninguna forma` does not restrict that claim to declarations. An IIFE can still write to `globalThis` or manipulate the DOM. Describe the guarantee specifically as keeping local declarations out of the surrounding scope.
6. **The public-path explanation does not match the helper's result.** [0420, line 352](sections/0420_rnd_microfrontend_dynamic_loading.typ#L352) says it calculates a path relative to the current document. The implementation at [example 11, line 145](../examples/11-concurrency-public-path/parent/src/index.ts#L145) resolves the remote entry against `document.baseURI`, then returns the absolute URL of the remote entry's directory. For example, a remote entry at `https://remote.example/assets/remote.js` produces `https://remote.example/assets/`. Describe the remote directory as the result and the document base as the fallback for resolving a relative input.
7. **The salary paragraph is only partly corrected.** [0200, line 96](sections/0200_project_plan.typ#L96) no longer says that one figure corroborates the other, which resolves that part. It still describes the INE breakdown as `por ocupación` before giving an economic-sector figure. The cited record's title is `Sexo y secciones de actividad` in [citations.bib, line 173](citations.bib#L173). Align that category description with the cited dataset. No current salary amounts have been externally revalidated.

### Revised wording to correct or clarify

- [0430, line 101](sections/0430_rnd_style_injection.typ#L101): `..., esta es, el inyector...` is not the explanatory connector `esto es`. Restore `..., esto es, el inyector...`, or use `..., que actúa como inyector...`. The original masculine `definido` can refer to the masculine noun `inyector`.
- [0430, line 163](sections/0430_rnd_style_injection.typ#L163): `tanto a la hora de registrar los estilos como el contenedor` has mismatched coordinated phrases. Use `a la hora de registrar tanto los estilos como el contenedor que los albergará`.

- [0500, line 50](sections/0500_user_guide.typ#L50): the keys are now plural but their description is still singular: `cuyas claves son el nombre del punto de entrada`. Use `cuyas claves son los nombres de los puntos de entrada`, or explicitly describe each individual key/value pair.
